summary: Iteration 5 end-to-end verification of the migration from ACRCloud to the free API stack (AcoustID + Chromaprint + MusicBrainz + Genius + Emergent LLM gpt-5.4) plus console-logged email verification and .edu student-plan gating. 19/19 backend pytest tests pass; frontend flows all pass after fixing a critical `fpBlock is not defined` ReferenceError that crashed every scan-detail view.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: `fpBlock is not defined` (and `fpEngine`) rendered every scan detail page as a red React error overlay. Root cause: derived variables were referenced (lines 101-117 etc.) but never declared. Fix applied: added `const fpBlock = result.fingerprint; const fpEngine = fpBlock?.engine || '';` right after the existing `result` / `V` derivations.

backend_tests_run: TestAuthVerification::test_verification_link_logged_and_verify PASS (grep from backend log, token verified, /me returns email_verified:true)
TestLyricScan::test_lyric_scan_famous_lyrics PASS (Vanilla Ice Ice Ice Baby -> verdict VIOLATION, top lyric similarity ~99%, engine 'Genius + AI Semantic', summary populated)
TestLyricScan::test_lyric_scan_original_lyrics PASS (unique lyrics -> verdict CLEAR/REVIEW, low similarity)
TestAudioScan::test_audio_scan_synthetic_tone PASS (15s 440Hz sine, fingerprint block present, engine 'AcoustID + MusicBrainz', 60 waveform bars, scan_modes.audio:true)
frontend_tests_run: Admin login -> dashboard loads, NO verify banner (admin.email_verified=true)
Fresh registration -> dashboard shows data-testid='dashboard-verify-banner' + resend button; clicking resend shows 'Verification link sent' toast

Lyric scan with Vanilla Ice lyrics -> after ~40s LLM call, navigates to /scan/<hex>; lyric analysis panel + summary ('almost exact reproduction of the iconic opening lines of Vanilla Ice\'s Ice Ice Baby...') + originality=1% + verdict=VIOLATION + 3 match rows (Ice Ice Baby, Vanilla Ice, 1987, 99.8% lyric similarity)
/verify-email?token=bogus -> shows 'Verification failed' + 'Invalid or expired verification link'
Existing scan detail (audio scan from prior iterations) now renders without runtime error after fpBlock fix
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL BUG FIXED: ScanResult.jsx referenced undeclared `fpBlock` and `fpEngine` — page threw ReferenceError before mount. Trivial derived-variable fix applied so the audio fingerprint panel renders correctly when result.fingerprint is present.

NewScan.jsx line 146: user-facing helper text still says 'Real fingerprinting via ACRCloud — matches against 90M+ licensed tracks with ISRC codes.' — after the migration this is misleading; primary engine is now AcoustID/MusicBrainz with ACRCloud only as fallback. Recommend rewording.

Fingerprint panel status_code color logic in ScanResult.jsx swaps CLEAR/VIOLATION colors: status_code === 0 (a MATCH was found) uses the red/lime 'violation' palette while 1001 (no match) uses the blue 'clean' palette — that matches business intent but is a bit counter-intuitive; comment recommended.

server.py `_analyze_audio` returns `engine = 'AcoustID + MusicBrainz'` even when AcoustID returned code 2004 'Unable to generate fingerprint' — consider surfacing 'Fingerprinting unavailable' when fpcalc fails.
server.py: `verify_email` accepts a raw dict (no Pydantic model) — works, but for consistency & OpenAPI docs a `VerifyEmailIn` model would be cleaner.
lyrics_free.py fetch_lyrics: Genius pages return 403 (Cloudflare) as documented — this is handled (candidate falls back to metadata-only), no fix required. Confirmed in log output during runs.
action_items: Update NewScan.jsx helper copy near audio uploader — remove 'Real fingerprinting via ACRCloud' claim and mention AcoustID/MusicBrainz.
Consider adding a Pydantic model for /auth/verify-email payload for OpenAPI clarity.
test_credentials: REDACTED_OBSOLETE_CREDENTIALS. Fresh disposable test users were generated per session by the archived pytest suite.
seed_data_creation: Pytest creates transient TEST_ prefixed users (test_iter5_*@example.com and test_iter5_*@stanford.edu) and TEST_ prefixed scans; scan docs are deleted at the end of each test. User docs are left in MongoDB (no cleanup fixture) — cheap and safe since emails are unique per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_soniccheck.py — re-run with `pytest -v tests/test_soniccheck.py`. Session-level admin_session sets Content-Type: application/json globally; when hitting /scans/upload use `requests.post` with a temporary header dict that drops Content-Type so multipart works (see TestLyricScan / TestAudioScan). Genius page scrape 403 is EXPECTED (candidate lyrics field ends up None, LLM falls back to its own knowledge). LLM lyric scans take 15-45s; keep timeouts at 120s.

rca of the issue.issue: Runtime error `fpBlock is not defined` on /scan/:id
rca of the issue.reproduction: 1) Log in as any user with at least one scan (or run a new scan). 2) Click any scan card / open /scan/<id>. 3) React renders <ScanResult/>, evaluates `{fpBlock && (...` on line 101, throws ReferenceError, entire route crashes to red error overlay.
rca of the issue.root_cause: During a refactor of ScanResult.jsx the fingerprint-panel JSX still references `fpBlock` and `fpEngine`, but the two lines that used to define them (something like `const fpBlock = result.fingerprint; const fpEngine = fpBlock?.engine ...`) were dropped and never re-added.
rca of the issue.mitigation: Added the two derivations immediately after `const V = verdictMap[...]` at the top of the ScanResult render body. Fix verified: after re-render, both the audio scan (with fingerprint) and lyric-only scan (fingerprint hidden by conditional) render cleanly and page-error count is zero.
